_comment: Hand-curated monthly highlights. Unlike data.json this file is never regenerated by refresh_data.py — edit it by hand when a month closes. The dashboard renders every item; render_recap.py draws only the ones carrying a 'card' headline.

2026-08.note: The month Solana's price, its governance, its block times and its distribution all moved at once — and its strongest monthly return in over a year.

items.t: Western Union's Stablecard goes live on Solana
items.b: A USDPT-backed Visa card, issued with Rain, live across 37 markets and spendable at Visa's 175M merchant locations, with Apple Pay and Google Pay support. USDPT's float was tiny at launch — roughly 7.4M tokens across 162 addresses — so the story here is distribution reach, not volume.

items.t: Jito's Q2 report puts BAM at a third of stake
items.b: Block Assembly Marketplace stake share rose from 28% to 33%, the JTX app-layer product went live with about $14M of early deposits, and JIP-38 routes 80% of JTX revenue share into JTO buybacks and burns for at least a year. JitoSOL fell to 9.85M SOL over the quarter as LST share fragmented.

items.t: A near miss, not an outage
items.b: A Teraswitch connectivity issue left 28.83% of stake missing consensus across 90 validators — below the 33.34% threshold that halts the chain — and cost about 333 SOL in rewards. Solana has now gone 30 consecutive months without a network-wide outage.

Activation began the week of 17 August, taking rent from 6,960 to 696 lamports per byte under SIMD-0437. A rent-exempt SPL token account falls from about $0.16 to $0.016 — an order of magnitude off the cost of holding state on Solana.

items.t: Shinhan signs on for a won-denominated tokenized fund
items.b: A four-party MOU with the Solana Foundation, Etherfuse and Orca to test a KRW ultra-short bond fund modelled on BUIDL, covering KYC/AML, issuance, FX and on-chain liquidity. A proof of concept rather than a live fund — Korean STO rules are expected in 2027.

items.t: Real-world assets pass $4B for the first time
items.b: Up from $3.9B on 16 August and roughly 3× where the ecosystem started 2026. Tokenized Treasuries on Solana stand at $1.2B, and the chain led every network with $378.2M of 30-day tokenized T-bill inflows against Ethereum's $272.2M. Solana holds 64–65% of global tokenized-stock DeFi deposits.

items.t: Jupiter Lend v2 clears $100M in weekly volume
items.b: The v2 AMM crossed $100M of 7-day volume two weeks after launch, built on the Smart Collateral and Smart Debt design. Jupiter Lend TVL was cited near $958M mid-month.

items.t: Solana perps cross $1.08T of cumulative volume
items.b: Jupiter Perps at $510B, Pacifica at $257B and Drift at $155B make up the bulk of it. Spot DEXs on Solana were reported above Bybit, Coinbase and Kraken combined for a ninth straight week.

items.t: Schwab says it will list spot SOL
items.b: Schwab Crypto will add spot SOL, AVAX and LINK in the coming months at 75 bps per trade with no custody fee, reaching 39.8M accounts and $13.1T of client assets. Announced, not live — the platform has offered BTC and ETH since May 2026.

items.t: The first binding on-chain vote passes Double Disinflation
items.b: SGP-0001 (Constitution) and SGP-0002 (Double Disinflation) passed; SGP-0003 (Resource and Inclusion Fee) failed at 53.9%. SGP-0002 doubles annual disinflation from 15% to 30%, pulling terminal 1.5% inflation forward to H1 2029 from 2032 and cutting roughly 18.9M SOL of issuance over six years. It cleared the two-thirds bar at 67.001% — 176.29M SOL for against 66.19M, on 60.7% of eligible stake and 1,326 validators. A mandate rather than an instant supply change: SIMD-0607 has to merge first so Agave and Firedancer compute identical staking rewards.

Two 50ms cuts landed in a single month — 400 to 350ms with Agave v4.2 the week of 17 August, then 300ms at epoch 1024 on 28 August. These are the first block-time cuts since genesis. Testnet is already running 200ms, the schedule is gated on skip-rate safeguards, and Alpenglow, targeting about 150ms finality, is queued for October.

items.t: Sanctum takes the top TVL spot
items.b: 18M SOL staked, $1.93B of TVL and 2.72% of circulating supply, up 52% over 30 days — enough to pass Jupiter at the top of DefiLlama's Solana rankings. The LST market has shifted toward multi-LST platforms.

items.t: 5.2 billion non-vote transactions, more than every other chain combined
items.b: A monthly record, up 24% on July's 4.2B, and the first month Solana settled more non-vote transactions than all other L1s and L2s together. Peak day 171.9M on 10 August; the week of 17–23 August alone did 1.318B, a fourth straight week above a billion. The headroom came from SIMD-0286, which lifted blocks from 60M to 100M compute units on 29 July.

items.t: Spot SOL ETFs post their best month since launch
items.b: Over $174M of net inflows, a record $153M week ending 31 August and a $60.91M day on 27 August, the third-largest since launch. Bitwise's BSOL became the first SOL ETF past $1B in assets, holding 9.33M SOL with 96% staked at a 5.80% net reward. Cumulative inflows since the October 2025 launch reached about $1.34B against $1.49B of category assets.
items.card: Best month yet for SOL ETFs

items.t: Circle mints $11B of USDC on Solana
items.b: The largest month of USDC issuance the network has seen, in repeated $250M tranches plus a $1B single-day window. That is gross minting rather than net supply — circulating USDC on Solana was cited near $8B by late August, more than a tenth of all USDC.

items.t: Goldman discloses an $88.1M SOL ETF book
items.b: Q2 13F filings reported in late August showed Goldman Sachs as the largest known institutional holder of US spot SOL ETFs at $88.1M as of 30 June, rebuilt after zeroing a roughly $107M position in Q1. A June snapshot disclosed in August, not an August purchase.
